hazards.title: Inadequate parapet at roof edge
hazards.description: A worker on the right is bent over working right at the roof edge, where the parapet is only about knee height, with no guardrail or visible personal fall arrest system despite a long drop to the site below.
hazards.category: Working at Heights and Fall Protection

hazards.title: Work inside open energized panel
hazards.description: A worker on the left is reaching into an open rooftop unit electrical enclosure with exposed wiring and components, and no lockout/tagout devices are visible.

hazards.title: Tools stored near roof edge
hazards.description: Power tools, a tool bag and hand tools sit on the roof surface close to the low parapet on the right, where they could be knocked over the edge onto the active site below.

hazards.title: Cords and hoses across walkway
hazards.description: Multiple black and orange extension cords and hoses are strewn loosely across the main roof walkway, creating trip hazards for workers moving between units and near the edge.

hazards.title: Low pipe supports in travel path
hazards.description: Low-mounted pipe racks, support stands and yellow equipment rails along the left side of the walkway project into the work area and present trip and shin-strike hazards.
